fields.name: SharedConfiguration.IDatabaseConfigurationOptions
fields.contract: Provider-specific database configuration option implementations expose DbConnectionsInternal as an array of IDatabaseConnectionConfiguration values. Consumers of SharedConfiguration.IDatabaseConfigurationOptions obtain the complete database-connection configuration collection through that property.
